title: Schwartz L2 membership and coordinate operations
statement: Use $\mathbf R,\mathbf C$ [def-weil-field] and Lebesgue measure on Euclidean $\mathbf R^m$, where $m\geq1$. Write $\mathcal S$ for the complex Schwartz class: smooth functions $\psi$ such that $\sup_x\|x\|^k\|D^n\psi(x)\|<\infty$ for every pair of integers $k,n\geq0$. Every $\psi\in\mathcal S$ is square-integrable. For every coordinate $1\leq j\leq m$, both $x\mapsto x_j\psi(x)$ and $\partial_{x_j}\psi$ belong to $\mathcal S$.
